title: HECTOR-Editor & HECTOR SKOS Vocabularies
description:
HECTOR-Editor is a lightweight desktop application built with Python and CustomTkinter for managing semantic SKOS vocabularies in the Digital Humanities and archaeological data management.

This repository also contains the HECTOR SKOS Vocabularies Collection (vocabularies/):

  • HECTOR Epoch SKOS Vocabulary (vocabularies/hector_epochs/HECTOR_Epoch.ttl)
  • HECTOR 3D Documentation SKOS Vocabulary (vocabularies/hector_3d_documentation/HECTOR_3D_Documentation.ttl)
  • HECTOR Heritage Assets SKOS Vocabulary (vocabularies/heritage_assets/heritage_assets.ttl)

Developed at the Bonn Center for Digital Humanities (BCDH) as part of the NFDI4Objects consortium (funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG) – Project number 441958489).
